description: ADR-0025: best-practices preset, three-day release age (as pnpm's minimumReleaseAge), one grouped weekly PR for minor and patch updates, majors separate, the full gate decides.

packageRules.description: One grouped pull request a week for minor and patch updates; majors keep their own pull requests.
The Playwright package and its pinned container move together: visual baselines are only valid in the matching image (ADR-0024). Never automerged, because snapshots may change.
Development-dependency patches merge themselves once the gate is green.
